prompt: Reply with exactly OK. Do not call tools or inspect any files.
second_prompt: Reply with exactly DONE. Do not call tools or inspect any files.
pricing_semantics: Crush-calculated session cost at Ollama published token rates, reported by the harness. This is not an account invoice; subscription discounts and credits are not inferred.
cache_rate_mapping: Crush v0.85.0 maps cost_per_1m_out_cached to CacheReadTokens and cost_per_1m_in_cached to CacheCreationTokens. Ollama gpt-oss:20b publishes a cached-input rate and no cache-creation rate.
sanitization: All IDs, join relationships, counters, cost floats, models, providers, timestamps, and non-content fields are retained. Session title and todos and message parts are replaced with planted placeholders. Only sessions/messages are exported, messages first to preserve timestamps under source triggers. No credentials, private context, files, logs, or reasoning text are included.
recipe: Use Crush v0.85.0 on linux/amd64 in a new empty project with separate CRUSH_GLOBAL_CONFIG, CRUSH_GLOBAL_DATA and CRUSH_CACHE_DIR directories.
Write config below to the isolated global crush.json; reuse OLLAMA_API_KEY from the environment. Set CRUSH_CLIENT_SERVER=0, CRUSH_DISABLE_DEFAULT_PROVIDERS=1 and CRUSH_DISABLE_PROVIDER_AUTO_UPDATE=1.
Run crush run --quiet --cwd <project> with prompt. Both model selections, tools, context paths and output limits are recorded in config. Each command has a 90-second outer timeout.
After exit 0, snapshot <project>/.crush/crush.db through SQLite read-only Connection.backup into first.db.
Run crush run --quiet --continue --cwd <project> with second_prompt; after exit 0, snapshot second.db the same way.
Export session/message accounting columns from each snapshot, replacing content only. Preserve the exact before/after cost relationship.
